title: Hearing on risks posed by artificial intelligence
summary: The Committee of the Whole held an oversight hearing on October 5, 2026 examining risks from artificial intelligence, alongside ten related bills covering topics like AI safety testing, chatbot privacy, deepfakes of officials, workplace reporting and whistleblower protections, and deceptive AI marketing. Officials from the Office of Technology and Innovation and NYC Emergency Management, along with industry and legal experts, were expected to testify. The briefing paper reviews AI's growing role in city government, risks such as bias, privacy loss and job displacement, and recent incidents involving major AI models.
